prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset vehicle.model-14 reusable cargo rocket, ONE genuine E engine-yaw READY view. Image1 is SELECTED NE physical model edit target. Image2 is SELECTED N view, a physical four-foot/body continuity reference. Image3 is E view/contact guide ONLY, not artwork.

Generate a NEW PHYSICAL YAW +45degrees from Image1 NE (+90degrees from Image2 N), around the upright VERTICAL hull axis. Original ONE blue service plate and ONE solid CLOSED charcoal access panel above it move to the extreme SCREEN-RIGHT TANGENT of the cream cylinder/capsule: show only their NARROW strongly foreshortened right-edge SLIVERS. They must NOT face the camera or remain broad visible rectangles. Dominant visible hull is PLAIN cream, with the single ochre waist band. Do not move a rear panel onto the front. This is E, not NE, and the rocket stays upright rather than tilting along an arrow.

Exactly the original ONE joined cream ogive capsule/cylindrical tank, ONE muted ochre waist band, ONE integrated graphite bell, and FOUR physical short graphite landing feet in square/cardinal arrangement. E is a90degree physical turn from N, so the fourfold-symmetric foot assembly has the same projection as Image2: THREE complete VISIBLE long feet LEFT, FRONT-CENTER and RIGHT; fourth rear foot is physically HIDDEN behind hull/bell. No little short rear pads sticking out at both sides of the bell: those would duplicate feet. Preserve original full foot pads/pivots/leg lengths and original hull diameter/height/profile. No fifth leg, second booster, fin, antenna, extra panel, window/cockpit, hatch opening, payload, cargo, probe, pod, exhaust, smoke or glow.

Same chunky M1 classic transport game materials, matte warm cream/pale gray, graphite bell/legs, muted ochre band, original dark-blue/charcoal panels only at right tangent; broad readable regions for native64x48. Fixed upper-left SCREEN light; do not rotate the light with the body. ORTHOGRAPHIC45degree azimuth,30degree CAMERA ELEVATION/native2:1 ground projection. Same physical model height and foot-plane center at native32,32, fixed64x48/(-32,-32).

ONE whole isolated E rocket centered on square1024x1024 genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA with at least120px true alpha clearance on EVERY SIDE, all three visible complete foot pads and bell included. No other model/view, scenery, platform, ground/floor patch, external cast shadow, backdrop, magenta/frame, colored guide/boxes/crosses, text/label/number/logo, road/rail/water. Reduce size uniformly if needed for clearance. Preserve clean complete alpha. Final E check: original service/access panels are narrow edge slivers on EXTREME RIGHT; three visible long feet only, fourth physically hidden.

selected original N four-foot/body continuity reference; E fourfold feet project the same after90degree yaw
labelled E engine/contact guide only; no guide becomes source art

findings: Genuine+45degree yaw from selected NE; original closed charcoal/blue face is now a thin screen-right tangent sliver, mostly hidden at native scale, with plain cream visible front. No panel was moved onto the front.

Same four-foot physical model; three visible full long left/front/right pads, far fourth physically hidden. No extra short rear pads; one cream joined capsule/tank, one graphite bell and ochre band, fixed screen lighting.
